app_info.subtitle: Review HR ops data
app_info.description: Solva HR helps HR and payroll teams look up employee work profiles, review pending approvals, inspect payroll run summaries, and check leave balances across tenant workspaces without changing live records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists company records and returns their names, slugs, and statuses without changing stored data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Solva HR tenant data and does not post to public websites or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or trigger irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches employee records and returns a light work-profile summary without editing the employee file.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads internal HR data and does not publish or send information outside the tenant workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify employee records or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves one employee's profile details and latest payroll snapshot without changing payroll or personnel data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private workspace data and does not transmit it to public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not update the employee file, payroll run, or approvals.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists pending approval tasks and requester context so users can review what still needs action.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads approval workflow data inside Solva HR and does not send approvals or notifications externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not approve, reject, delete, or otherwise change task state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns summary totals for an existing payroll run and does not process or reopen payroll.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private payroll data from Solva HR and does not publish or submit it elsewhere.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter payroll values, deductions, or run status.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves leave balances and recent leave requests for one employee without creating or editing leave records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads leave data in the private tenant workspace and does not write to public or external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change leave balances, requests, or approval outcomes.

test_cases.description: List tenant workspaces available in Solva HR.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the companies currently set up in Solva HR.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the available company names, slugs, and statuses so the user can choose a tenant workspace.

test_cases.description: Find an employee by name inside Robot Cafe & Bistro.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find Dickson Ndirangu in Robot Cafe & Bistro and show me his department and branch.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the matching employee record with work-profile fields such as designation, department, branch, and status.

test_cases.description: Inspect one employee profile with latest payroll context.
test_cases.user_prompt: Get the work profile for employee RC-048 in Robot Cafe & Bistro.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the employee's profile summary, supervisor, and latest payroll snapshot without exposing edit controls.

test_cases.description: Review pending approvals for a specific tenant.
test_cases.user_prompt: What pending approvals are waiting in Robot Cafe & Bistro right now?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns pending approval tasks with module, owner role, stage, requester context, and created time.

test_cases.description: Summarize the latest payroll run for a tenant.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the latest payroll run summary for Robot Cafe & Bistro.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the latest payroll run totals including gross pay, net pay, statutory totals, deductions, and run status.

test_cases.description: Check leave balances for an employee.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the leave balance summary for employee RC-048 in Robot Cafe & Bistro.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns current leave balances and recent pending or approved leave requests for the selected employee.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated weather requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Will it rain in Nairobi tomorrow afternoon?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because weather forecasting is outside Solva HR's supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for editing or sending email requests the tools do not support.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send an email to all staff telling them payroll has closed.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because these tools do not send messages or perform outbound communications.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for state-changing payroll actions not exposed by the server.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Approve the pending leave request and run month-end payroll now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the current MCP surface is read-only and cannot approve tasks or process payroll.
